name: Switch
description: Pure-CSS switch on <input type="checkbox" role="switch">: thumb that slides on a spring and stretches when pressed, icons in the thumb (customizable), sizes, label on the left or right, option card.
useWhen: A setting turns on or off and takes effect immediately, as in a preferences panel
A list of settings needs on/off rows or option cards with descriptions

avoidWhen.when: The choice only applies after submitting a form, or is an agreement such as accepting terms
The control is a toolbar button that stays pressed, such as Bold
The user chooses between two named modes rather than on and off

classes.name: mv-choice / mv-choice-card
classes.description: Shared label and card (checkbox component). data-control="end" puts the switch to the right of the label (settings row).

attributes.name: data-shape
attributes.description: Slightly rounded corners instead of a pill.

attributes.name: data-icons
attributes.description: Shows an icon in the thumb (✕ / ✓ by default).

a11y: role="switch" on a native checkbox: state announced as “on / off”, Space toggles, value submitted with the form. The wrapping <label> provides the name; link a description via aria-describedby if needed. Icons are decorative (pseudo-elements).
